description: Defines a template class TrafficRecorder for tracking network traffic data over time, including methods for initialization, updating, reading, and printing traffic statistics.

classes.name: TrafficRecorder
classes.description: A template class for recording and analyzing network traffic bytes over time, with methods for updating clock, reading total bytes, reading bytes in a period, writing bytes, and printing statistics.

methods.name: TrafficRecorder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the traffic recorder with a specified size and record limit.

methods.name: ~TrafficRecorder
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up allocated arrays.

methods.name: updateClock
methods.description: Updates the internal clock to the current time.

methods.name: readBytesForLastPeriod
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes recorded in the last specified period.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Records a new byte count at the current clock time.

methods.name: printAccuBitsForLastPeriod
methods.description: Prints traffic statistics for the last period, including number of units and bytes.
